ticket.summary: Constant drip at bathroom faucet, original ~1990s fixture; likely cartridge/washer rebuild, possible faucet replacement if body is corroded.
mitigation_advice: Optional overnight fix: close the oval shutoff valve on the supply line under the sink, clockwise until snug, to stop the drip [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Faucet/shower cartridge replacement - bathroom faucet drip

ticket.customer_message: Sorry we missed your call! A nightly drip is a standard non-emergency fix, usually a worn cartridge or washer. Flat rate $159 (FAUCET-CARTRIDGE), parts and labor, about 60-75 min given the fixture's age. If the faucet body is too corroded to rebuild, the tech will quote a replacement before doing any work. To stop the drip tonight, close the small oval shutoff valve under the sink (clockwise until snug) [PB-01]. I can book you for Tuesday Sept 1 at 10:30 AM - reply 'yes' and a dispatcher will confirm in the morning.
